payload.summary: Choose and enforce a trusted server decoded-audio duration limit
payload.detail: 2026-11-05 backend audit (F08), local source33f6478: 120second synthetic WAV reaches mocked provider with absent/forged duration metadata. Byte/rate caps exist; no trusted duration cap across accepted compressed formats or declared decoder/runtime contract. Next: Choose supported duration/formats and bounded trusted decoder; verify package/image supply chain and time/memory limits before enforcing decoded duration. Acceptance: Actual synthetic accepted-format boundary, forged metadata, malformed/oversized/decompression/cancellation and decoder failure tests refuse safely before provider work. No WAV-only or client-metadata substitute. Suggested owner: API + Delivery + product owner. No merge, deployment, live migration, provider spending or specialist approval is granted by logging this task.
